title: Fold
tagline: Crease a paper square into the dashed shape, one fold at a time.
how_to: Drag one point of the paper onto another point; the paper creases halfway between and folds over.
description: Seven flat-folding puzzles on a red-and-cream square of paper. Drag a point onto another and the crease forms exactly between them, stacking layers that fold with a little shadow. Match the dashed silhouette; try to do it in as few folds as the recipe.
spark: Taken literally: origami, reduced to its simplest honest move, the flat fold.
proud_of: Folds are real geometry: every layer is split, mirrored and re-stacked, so flaps correctly cover and flip colour.
